newsitem.title: USA: Midwest spot butane up, other liquids stable.
newsitem.headline: Midwest spot butane up, other liquids stable.

text.p: Spot normal butane prices in the U.S. Midwest continued to strengthen in late Wednesday activity as players took advantage of a widening spread with the U.S. Gulf Coast, players said.
Spot butane in the U.S. Gulf has been weakening this week partly due to imports coming into the hub.
In late trade, Conway, Kansas, material rose about 0.75 cent to between 35.00 cents and 35.25 cents a gallon on demand by players trying to ship the material south.
Belvieu normal was pegged largely unchanged at 38.50/38.75 cents.
Activity in Belvieu was dampened by the annual crawfish boil in Houston sponsored by PetroSource.
Belvieu propane was 34.75/35.00 cents, with both sides of the range done. Conway material was on par. ((--Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631))
